reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: /oauth/token is a live public HTTP endpoint (public API exception applies; external OAuth clients are the intended callers). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is untrusted external HTTP. Gate 3: Custom STEM OAuth PKCE flow is explicitly in scope (key_security_concerns). An attacker can trigger this via /oauth/token by sending two parallel POST requests with the same valid auth code before either request's delete_authorization_code RPC executes, causing both requests to hold authCode in memory, pass all downstream validation (client_id, redirect_uri, expiry, PKCE at L86-120), and receive independent JWT access tokens from a single auth code exchange — breaking the one-time-use guarantee of RFC 6749 §10.5.
